sentences.text: Dorothy lived in the middle of Kansas.

translations.en: Dorothy lived in the middle of Kansas.
translations.fr: Dorothée vivait au milieu du Kansas.
translations.es: Dorita vivía en medio de Kansas.

sentences.text: She lived with Uncle Henry and Aunt Em.

translations.en: She lived with Uncle Henry and Aunt Em.
translations.fr: Elle vivait avec son oncle Henry et sa tante Em.
translations.es: Vivía con su tío Henry y su tía Em.

sentences.text: Uncle Henry was a hardworking farmer.

translations.en: Uncle Henry was a hardworking farmer.
translations.fr: L'oncle Henry était un fermier travailleur.
translations.es: El tío Henry era un granjero trabajador.

sentences.text: Their wooden house was small and humble.

translations.en: Their wooden house was small and humble.
translations.fr: Leur maison en bois était petite et modeste.
translations.es: Su casa de madera era pequeña y humilde.

sentences.text: They had one room and a small cellar under the floor.

translations.en: They had one room and a small cellar under the floor.
translations.fr: Ils avaient une seule pièce et une petite cave sous le plancher.
translations.es: Tenían una sola habitación y un pequeño sótano bajo el suelo.

sentences.text: The great prairie was flat and dry.

translations.en: The great prairie was flat and dry.
translations.fr: La grande prairie était plate et sèche.
translations.es: La gran pradera era plana y seca.

sentences.text: Not a single tree grew near the little house.

translations.en: Not a single tree grew near the little house.
translations.fr: Pas un seul arbre ne poussait près de la petite maison.
translations.es: Ni un solo árbol crecía cerca de la casita.

sentences.text: The hot summer sun burned the land.

translations.en: The hot summer sun burned the land.
translations.fr: Le chaud soleil d'été brûlait la terre.
translations.es: El cálido sol de verano quemaba la tierra.

sentences.text: The grass was gray and dry.

translations.en: The grass was gray and dry.
translations.fr: L'herbe était grise et sèche.
translations.es: La hierba estaba gris y seca.

sentences.text: Even the wood of the house was gray.

translations.en: Even the wood of the house was gray.
translations.fr: Même le bois de la maison était gris.
translations.es: Incluso la madera de la casa era gris.

sentences.text: Dorothy had a little black dog.

translations.en: Dorothy had a little black dog.
translations.fr: Dorothée avait un petit chien noir.
translations.es: Dorita tenía un perrito negro.

sentences.text: His name was Toto.

translations.en: His name was Toto.
translations.fr: Son nom était Toto.
translations.es: Su nombre era Toto.

sentences.text: Toto had shiny black eyes and soft black hair.

translations.en: Toto had shiny black eyes and soft black hair.
translations.fr: Toto avait des yeux noirs brillants et des poils noirs doux.
translations.es: Toto tenía ojos negros brillantes y pelo negro suave.

sentences.text: He played games with Dorothy every single day.

translations.en: He played games with Dorothy every single day.
translations.fr: Il jouait à des jeux avec Dorothée chaque jour.
translations.es: Jugaba a juegos con Dorita todos los días.

sentences.text: The little dog made Dorothy laugh and smile.

translations.en: The little dog made Dorothy laugh and smile.
translations.fr: Le petit chien faisait rire et sourire Dorothée.
translations.es: El perrito hacía reír y sonreír a Dorita.

sentences.text: Uncle Henry worked hard from early morning until dark night.

translations.en: Uncle Henry worked hard from early morning until dark night.
translations.fr: L'oncle Henry travaillait dur du matin tôt jusqu'à la nuit noire.
translations.es: El tío Henry trabajaba duro desde temprano en la mañana hasta la noche oscura.

sentences.text: He rarely smiled and never laughed aloud.

translations.en: He rarely smiled and never laughed aloud.
translations.fr: Il souriait rarement et ne riait jamais à voix haute.
translations.es: Rara vez sonreía y nunca se reía en voz alta.

sentences.text: Aunt Em was also very quiet and sad.

translations.en: Aunt Em was also very quiet and sad.
translations.fr: La tante Em était aussi très silencieuse et triste.
translations.es: La tía Em también era muy silenciosa y triste.

sentences.text: The dry prairie had taken away her bright smile.

translations.en: The dry prairie had taken away her bright smile.
translations.fr: La prairie sèche avait emporté son sourire éclatant.
translations.es: La pradera seca le había quitado su brillante sonrisa.

sentences.text: Only little Toto brought joy to Dorothy.

translations.en: Only little Toto brought joy to Dorothy.
translations.fr: Seul le petit Toto apportait de la joie à Dorothée.
translations.es: Solo el pequeño Toto le daba alegría a Dorita.

sentences.text: One afternoon, the sky turned very dark and cold.

translations.en: One afternoon, the sky turned very dark and cold.
translations.fr: Un après-midi, le ciel devint très sombre et froid.
translations.es: Una tarde, el cielo se volvió muy oscuro y frío.

sentences.text: A strong wind blew from the north.

translations.en: A strong wind blew from the north.
translations.fr: Un vent violent soufflait du nord.
translations.es: Un viento fuerte soplaba desde el norte.

sentences.text: Uncle Henry stood outside and looked at the black clouds.

translations.en: Uncle Henry stood outside and looked at the black clouds.
translations.fr: L'oncle Henry se tenait dehors et regardait les nuages noirs.
translations.es: El tío Henry se quedó afuera y miró las nubes negras.

sentences.text: He heard a low sound across the empty plains.

translations.en: He heard a low sound across the empty plains.
translations.fr: Il entendit un bruit sourd à travers les plaines vides.
translations.es: Oyó un sonido grave a través de las llanuras vacías.

sentences.text: "A great cyclone is coming!" Uncle Henry shouted loudly.

translations.en: "A great cyclone is coming!" Uncle Henry shouted loudly.
translations.fr: « Un grand cyclone arrive ! » cria très fort l'oncle Henry.
translations.es: —¡Viene un gran ciclón! —gritó con fuerza el tío Henry.

sentences.text: "Run to the cellar right now!" Aunt Em cried.

translations.en: "Run to the cellar right now!" Aunt Em cried.
translations.fr: « Courez à la cave tout de suite ! » s'écria la tante Em.
translations.es: —¡Corran al sótano ahora mismo! —exclamó la tía Em.

sentences.text: She pulled open the small wooden door in the floor.

translations.en: She pulled open the small wooden door in the floor.
translations.fr: Elle ouvrit la petite trappe en bois dans le plancher.
translations.es: Abrió la pequeña puerta de madera en el suelo.

sentences.text: Aunt Em climbed down quickly into the dark shelter.

translations.en: Aunt Em climbed down quickly into the dark shelter.
translations.fr: La tante Em descendit rapidement dans le sombre abri.
translations.es: La tía Em bajó de prisa al refugio oscuro.

sentences.text: Dorothy ran across the room to catch Toto.

translations.en: Dorothy ran across the room to catch Toto.
translations.fr: Dorothée courut à travers la pièce pour attraper Toto.
translations.es: Dorita corrió por la habitación para atrapar a Toto.

sentences.text: The little dog was frightened by the terrible wind.

translations.en: The little dog was frightened by the terrible wind.
translations.fr: Le petit chien était effrayé par le vent terrible.
translations.es: El perrito estaba asustado por el viento terrible.

sentences.text: He ran under the bed and hid in the shadow.

translations.en: He ran under the bed and hid in the shadow.
translations.fr: Il courut sous le lit et se cacha dans l'ombre.
translations.es: Corrió debajo de la cama y se escondió en la sombra.

sentences.text: Dorothy picked him up safely in her arms.

translations.en: Dorothy picked him up safely in her arms.
translations.fr: Dorothée le prit prudemment dans ses bras.
translations.es: Dorita lo tomó con cuidado en sus brazos.

sentences.text: Suddenly, a loud crash shook the entire building.

translations.en: Suddenly, a loud crash shook the entire building.
translations.fr: Soudain, un bruit fracassant secoua tout le bâtiment.
translations.es: De repente, un fuerte estruendo sacudió todo el edificio.

sentences.text: A mighty blast of air struck the house.

translations.en: A mighty blast of air struck the house.
translations.fr: Une puissante rafale d'air frappa la maison.
translations.es: Una ráfaga de aire poderosa golpeó la casa.

sentences.text: The house rose slowly up into the wild sky.

translations.en: The house rose slowly up into the wild sky.
translations.fr: La maison monta lentement dans le ciel déchaîné.
translations.es: La casa se elevó lentamente hacia el cielo furioso.

sentences.text: It spun around and around in the violent air.

translations.en: It spun around and around in the violent air.
translations.fr: Elle tournoya encore et encore dans l'air violent.
translations.es: Giró y giró en el aire violento.

sentences.text: The house flew high above the dark gray clouds.

translations.en: The house flew high above the dark gray clouds.
translations.fr: La maison vola haut au-dessus des nuages gris foncé.
translations.es: La casa voló muy alto sobre las nubes grises y oscuras.

sentences.text: Dorothy held Toto tight against her warm chest.

translations.en: Dorothy held Toto tight against her warm chest.
translations.fr: Dorothée serrait fort Toto contre sa poitrine chaude.
translations.es: Dorita apretó a Toto contra su pecho cálido.

sentences.text: The strong wind carried them through the empty air.

translations.en: The strong wind carried them through the empty air.
translations.fr: Le vent puissant les transportait à travers l'air vide.
translations.es: El viento fuerte los llevó por el aire vacío.

sentences.text: It felt like riding a boat on a stormy river.

translations.en: It felt like riding a boat on a stormy river.
translations.fr: C'était comme voguer sur un bateau au milieu d'un fleuve agité.
translations.es: Se sentía como viajar en un bote sobre un río tormentoso.

sentences.text: Many long hours passed inside the floating house.

translations.en: Many long hours passed inside the floating house.
translations.fr: Plusieurs longues heures passèrent à l'intérieur de la maison volante.
translations.es: Pasaron muchas horas largas dentro de la casa flotante.

sentences.text: The strange rocking motion became gentle and steady.

translations.en: The strange rocking motion became gentle and steady.
translations.fr: L'étrange balancement devint doux et régulier.
translations.es: El extraño balanceo se volvió suave y constante.

sentences.text: Dorothy crawled onto her soft little bed.

translations.en: Dorothy crawled onto her soft little bed.
translations.fr: Dorothée rampa sur son petit lit douillet.
translations.es: Dorita gateó hasta su suave camita.

sentences.text: She closed her eyes and soon fell fast asleep.

translations.en: She closed her eyes and soon fell fast asleep.
translations.fr: Elle ferma les yeux et s'endormit bientôt profondément.
translations.es: Cerró los ojos y pronto se quedó profundamente dormida.
